Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

Position: LLM Engineer / Prompt Engineer

Location: Philippines

Work setup & shift: Onsite/Hybrid/Remote

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses
A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.
Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.
Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your Role:

As an LLM Engineer / Prompt Engineer, you will:
Design, develop, and optimize prompts and workflows for large language model (LLM) applications.
Build and maintain AI-driven solutions such as chatbots, copilots, and intelligent automation systems.
Evaluate model outputs and implement strategies to improve accuracy, relevance, and safety.
Collaborate with data engineers and software developers to integrate LLM capabilities into production systems.
Experiment with model tuning approaches, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and prompt engineering techniques.

What You Need:

Non-negotiables

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
2–5 years of experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or NLP-related roles

Strong proficiency in Python

Experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI models, open-source LLMs, or similar platforms)
Understanding of prompt engineering principles and model evaluation techniques

Preferred skills/expertise

Experience with RAG frameworks and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate)
Familiarity with APIs for LLM integration and orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Understanding of NLP concepts such as embeddings, tokenization, and fine-tuning
Experience working in Agile or experimental product environments

About MicroSourcing

With over 9,000 professionals across 13 delivery centers, MicroSourcing is the pioneer and largest offshore provider of managed services in the Philippines.

Our commitment to 100% YOU

MicroSourcing firmly believes that our company's strength lies in our people's diversity and talent. We are proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces individuals of all races, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds. We provide space for everyone, embracing different perspectives, and making room for opportunities for each individual to thrive.

At MicroSourcing, equality is not merely a slogan – it's our commitment. Our way of life. Here, we don't just accept your unique authentic self - we celebrate it, valuing every individual's contribution to our collective success and growth. Join us in celebrating YOU and your 100%!

For more information, visit

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

About the Role

As an LLM Application Engineer, you will build the intelligence layer that powers ActAI's AI experiences.

You will work at the intersection of LLMs, software engineering, and product - designing agent workflows, improving model behaviour, and turning AI capabilities into reliable user experiences.

You will own problems end-to-end, from understanding user needs, designing Agentic workflows, integrating models and tools, building evaluation system and continuously improving AI behaviour in production.

Focus

  • Build and ship LLM-powered applications and AI agent workflows

  • Design systems for reasoning, planning, memory, tool uuse and multi-step execution

  • Build reliable orchestration pipelines that turn probabilistic model outputs into predictable, observable, and safe actions

  • Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, search, internal services, and external tools.

  • Develop prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, and other techniques to improve model behaviour

  • Build evaluation frameworks and datasets to measure AI quality, reliability, and regressions

  • Debug AI systems across the entire stack—from model behaviour and prompts to orchestration, backend services, and product UX

  • Optimise AI systems for quality, latency, and cost

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to turn ambiguous product problems into working AI solutions

  • Establish production practices for observability, tracing, experimentation, evaluation, and continuous improvement

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • LLM APIs and model providers, including OpenAI-compatible APIs and open-weight models

  • Agent frameworks and orchestration systems

  • Vector databases and retrieval systems

  • Backend services, APIs, and distributed systems

  • PyTorch / JAX

Ideal Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building AI-powered applications

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, generative AI, or agent-based systems

  • Experience designing prompts, workflows, evaluations, or AI behaviour

  • Ability to write clean, production-quality code

  • Comfortable working across abstraction layers (model → system → product)

  • Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement

Outcomes

  • AI features reach production quickly and deliver measurable user impact

  • LLM-powered workflows are reliable, scalable, observable, and maintainable

  • AI quality improves through systematic evaluation, experimentation, and iteration

  • AI workflows become increasingly predictable, efficient, and cost-effective

  • Complex AI capabilities are translated into simple, intuitive user experiences

About us:Blue Rose Research builds data and AI tools that help Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We forecast races, test ads at scale, and use AI to track what's breaking in the news, then help campaigns respond fast with messages that actually move voters. Our work has guided how hundreds of millions of dollars are spent by the country's top campaigns and progressive organizations. We're a small, mission-driven team of engineers, data scientists, and political strategists who build fast, experiment boldly, and care deeply about using technology for good.

Machine Learning Lead (LLM) The 2028 cycle starts the day after the midterms, and a wide-open Democratic presidential primary will begin almost immediately. With a crowded field and a fragmented media environment, campaigns will need to understand what's reaching and persuading voters faster than ever, and our tools will be at the center of that work from the first days of the primary through the general election.

We're hiring a Machine Learning Lead to guide a small team of senior data scientists building the LLM-powered research and analysis tools behind that effort. The team's core work is making AI systems we can trust and improve. That means training judge models that tell us whether outputs are accurate, well-grounded, and useful, and then using those judges to automatically optimize the context, prompts, and retrieval that power our products. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you'll own the roadmap, develop the team, and stay hands-on in the technical work. You'll be joining at the start of the cycle, with time to build systems that are ready before the pressure peaks rather than scrambling to catch up.

You will:

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on AI Operations Specialist to own and improve our production AI conversation systems.

We are an AI-powered SMS lead recovery platform serving telehealth brands, processing millions of messages each month. Our AI systems interact directly with customers, and their performance directly impacts client conversions.

In this role, you'll onboard new clients, configure AI conversation systems, monitor live conversations, diagnose issues, improve prompts and system behavior, and measure whether your changes actually improve conversion.

This is not a theoretical AI role. We're looking for someone who has run LLM systems in production and understands how to continuously monitor, troubleshoot, test, and improve them.

Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & AI Setup

  • Onboard new clients into the AI conversation platform.
  • Set up webhook integrations and client knowledge bases.
  • Configure campaigns and conversation workflows.
  • Ensure new client systems are properly tested before going live.
  • Troubleshoot integration and configuration issues during onboarding.

Production AI Operations

  • Monitor live AI-generated conversations and customer interactions.
  • Review conversations to identify errors, inconsistencies, and missed opportunities.
  • Diagnose AI failure modes and determine their root causes.
  • Identify issues affecting conversation quality and conversion.
  • Escalate technical issues when necessary and follow through until resolved.

Prompt & System Optimization

  • Write, edit, and improve prompts that generate customer-facing messages.
  • Adjust system instructions and conversation logic based on real-world performance.
  • Test changes systematically before and after deployment.
  • Maintain documentation of prompt and system changes.
  • Continuously improve AI behavior while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Performance & Conversion Analysis

  • Analyze conversation transcripts and performance data.
  • Measure whether system and prompt changes improve conversion.
  • Identify patterns across conversations that can inform future improvements.
  • Track key performance outcomes and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Use data and real customer interactions to guide optimization decisions.

Founder Collaboration

  • Work directly with the founder on daily AI operations and improvements.
  • Communicate issues, findings, and recommendations clearly.
  • Take ownership of problems from identification through resolution.
  • Move quickly while maintaining high standards for customer-facing AI output.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Proven experience running LLM or AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience monitoring and improving production AI outputs.
  • Experience with prompt engineering and system prompt optimization.
  • Strong understanding of LLM behavior, failure modes, and iterative testing.
  • Experience analyzing AI-generated conversations or customer-facing outputs.
  • Ability to work with webhooks, APIs, knowledge bases, or similar integrations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written English — required for editing customer-facing AI messages and documenting system changes.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of production systems.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You've actually operated AI systems in production rather than only experimenting with ChatGPT.
  • You are comfortable reviewing hundreds or thousands of AI interactions to identify patterns and problems.
  • You think in terms of outcomes and conversion, not just whether the AI response sounds good.
  • You are methodical about testing changes and measuring their impact.
  • You can quickly identify why an AI system is behaving incorrectly and determine how to improve it.
  • You communicate clearly and document your work thoroughly.
  • You enjoy working directly with a founder in a fast-moving environment.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

You'll begin by reviewing the performance of live AI conversations and looking for unusual patterns, failures, or opportunities for improvement.

You may spend part of the day onboarding a new telehealth client, configuring their knowledge base and integrations, and setting up their campaigns.

You'll also review conversation transcripts, identify issues with AI responses, update prompts or system instructions, test your changes, and monitor the resulting conversion performance.

Throughout the day, you'll work directly with the founder to discuss findings, prioritize improvements, and make sure production systems continue performing effectively.
